svg.title: The Necropolis moon and its error
svg.desc: Eight moon phases as drawn, the lit fraction over six months for the model and an almanac-grade reference, and the phase-time error at each new moon from 2000 to 2040.
svg.text: The necropolis moon: a mean lunation against the real sky
model: age = (t - 2000-01-06 18:14 UTC) mod 29.530588853 d, lit = (1 - cos(2 pi age / month)) / 2
Phase-time error at each new moon
Model error against the reference, 2000-2040 (hourly samples): lit fraction rms 0.035, largest 0.103; new-moon time error from -17.5 to +10.0 h (rms 8.4 h).
The model's epoch is a true new moon, not a mean one; the true phase differs from a uniform clock by up to about half a day because the moon's orbit is eccentric and perturbed by the sun.
